name: Plumbing Services
description: Independent tradesperson or small crew offering pipe-fitting, sanitary-ware installation, water-supply line laying, drainage repair, and leak/appliance maintenance for households, apartments and small commercial buildings.
target_customers: Households, apartment complexes/builders, small commercial establishments, real-estate developers, municipal/PWD maintenance contracts
typical_investment_range_summary: Basic hand-tool kit for an independent plumber is low-cost (a few thousand rupees for pipe wrenches, cutters, threading tools); no authoritative government cost study for a 'typical' plumber toolkit was located. Plumbers qualify as 'service business owners' under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY), giving access to collateral-free credit tiers of Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishor (Rs 50,001-5 lakh) and Tarun (Rs 5-10 lakh) for tools/handcart/vehicle -- these are loan-ceiling tiers, not a measured 'typical cost', so treat as PENDING_VERIFICATION/portal-estimate for the specific rupee figure.
training_availability_summary: DGT/NCVT 'Plumber' trade under the Craftsman Training Scheme (CTS) is a 1-year (2 semester) ITI course leading to a National Trade Certificate, offered at ITIs across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. Short-term 'Plumber (General)' course is also offered under PMKVY via NSDC-affiliated training partners (approx. 360 hours: 120 theory + 200 practical + 40 employability/entrepreneurship).
licenses_required_summary: No formal state/central license is required to practice independent plumbing work in India. A local Shop & Establishment registration (state-specific, fee Rs 200-5,000) and GST registration (mandatory once turnover crosses Rs 20 lakh) apply only if operating as a registered firm/shop, not to individual freelance plumbers.
government_schemes_summary: PMKVY (Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana) short-term training; Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) for working-capital/tool loans; PM Vishwakarma Yojana does NOT list 'Plumber' among its 18 covered trades (verified against the official trade list) so plumbers are not eligible for its Rs 15,000 toolkit incentive.
data_source: NSDC/PMKVY course pages; DGT/NCVT ITI syllabus portals; PMMY official guidance; PM Vishwakarma official trade list (PIB)
notes: Training-duration and PM Vishwakarma-exclusion facts are government-sourced (capped 85 eligible) but the specific 'typical investment' rupee figure is not backed by any authoritative cost study, so composite confidence is capped lower (70) and that sub-field is flagged portal-estimate-only.

name: Electrical Services (Domestic Wiring & Wireman Work)
description: Wireman/electrician-level tradesperson carrying out domestic and small-commercial wiring, fitting, repair and maintenance of electrical installations, appliance connections, and minor fault-rectification.
target_customers: Households, small shops/offices, apartment builders, electrical contracting firms (as subcontracted wireman)
typical_investment_range_summary: Entry-level tool kit (pliers, testers, wire strippers, drill) is low-cost; no authoritative government cost benchmark located for a 'typical' independent-electrician toolkit investment. PENDING_VERIFICATION for a specific rupee figure -- treat as portal-estimate only.
training_availability_summary: DGT/NCVT 'Electrician' trade (1-year ITI, CTS/NSQF) at ITIs in Telangana/AP; NSDC/PMKVY 'Assistant Electrician' short course (approx. 440 hours: 110 theory + 290 practical + 40 employability/entrepreneurship). After ITI/experience, candidates sit the Wireman Competency Certificate exam conducted by the State Board of Technical Education & Training (SBTET), Hyderabad on behalf of the Chief Electrical Inspector/Telangana State Electrical Licensing Board.
licenses_required_summary: A Wireman Competency Certificate/permit (issued under the Telangana State Electrical Licensing Regulations, 2018, administered by the Chief Electrical Inspectorate) is legally required to independently carry out electrical wiring/installation work above basic domestic scope; eligibility is 10th pass + 4 years' certified experience under a licensed contractor/firm, minimum age 21, with experience certified by a Deputy Electrical Inspector or equivalent TRANSCO/GENCO/DISCOM engineer.
government_schemes_summary: PMKVY short-term training; Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana for tool/working-capital loans; PM Vishwakarma Yojana does NOT include 'Electrician' among its 18 trades, so the toolkit incentive does not apply.
data_source: NSDC PMKVY course page; DGT/NCVT syllabus; Telangana State Electrical Licensing Regulations 2018 summaries (Electrical4u, Indiankanoon); PIB PM Vishwakarma trade list
notes: Licensing requirement is a real, verifiable state regulation (Telangana State Electrical Licensing Regulations 2018) sourced via secondary legal-summary sites, not a direct fetch of the primary G.O.; recommend a follow-up direct check of the Telangana Electrical Inspectorate portal when egress restrictions are lifted. Investment figure is unverified/portal-estimate.

name: Electrical Contracting (Licensed Supervisor/Contractor)
description: Higher-tier electrical livelihood: a licensed Electrical Supervisor or Electrical Contractor who can take on larger wiring/installation projects, employ wiremen, and sign off on electrical installation compliance for buildings.
target_customers: Builders/developers, commercial and industrial establishments, government works contracts, DISCOM-linked installation work
typical_investment_range_summary: No authoritative government cost study located for the capital needed to set up as an electrical contracting firm (vehicle, tools, office, licensing/exam fees); set to PENDING_VERIFICATION, portal-estimate-only.
training_availability_summary: Progression route is ITI Electrician/Wireman certificate plus supervised field experience, followed by the Electrical Supervisor Competency Certificate exam conducted by SBTET Hyderabad on behalf of the Chief Electrical Inspector/Telangana State Electrical Licensing Board.
licenses_required_summary: Electrical Supervisor Certificate requires 10th pass + 8 years' certified installation experience, OR an ITI Wireman/Electrician certificate + 4 years' experience; experience must be attested by a Deputy Electrical Inspector/Divisional Engineer (TRANSCO/GENCO/DISCOM) or equivalent. A separate Electrical Contractor License (registration with the state Electrical Inspectorate) is additionally required to operate as a contracting firm under the Indian Electricity Rules framework administered at state level.
government_schemes_summary: No dedicated central scheme identified specifically for electrical-contractor licensing costs; general MSME/Mudra credit lines apply for firm working capital. PM Vishwakarma does not cover this trade.
data_source: SBTET/Telangana Electrical Licensing Board procedure summaries (Electrical4u, Wikiprocedure); Telangana State Electrical Licensing Regulations, 2018 (secondary summary)
notes: Licensing eligibility criteria (years of experience, exam authority) are drawn from secondary summaries of the state G.O./regulations rather than a direct primary-source fetch (blocked this session); recommend verifying directly against the Telangana Electrical Inspectorate/SBTET official notification. This is an urban/large-project-oriented tier, distinct from row 2's basic wireman-level livelihood.

name: Welding & Metal Fabrication
description: Skilled trade covering arc/gas welding, and fabrication of steel gates, grills, staircases, sheds, and structural metal work, either as an independent welder or a small fabrication workshop.
target_customers: Households (gates/grills/staircases), builders/contractors, small industries needing structural fabrication, agricultural equipment repair
typical_investment_range_summary: A PMEGP/KVIC-linked welding-workshop case (Jewargi, Karnataka) had a total project cost of approx. Rs 4.88 lakh (term loan Rs 4.64 lakh + KVIC margin-money subsidy Rs 1.22 lakh + own contribution Rs 24,431), projected annual turnover Rs 12 lakh with 2 employees. This is one sanctioned example under PMEGP, not a fixed official minimum -- actual entry cost for a solo welder with basic transformer-set and hand tools would be considerably lower and is PENDING_VERIFICATION.
training_availability_summary: DGT/NCVT 'Welder' trade (1 year, NSQF Level 3) and 'Welder (Fabrication & Fitting)'/'Welder (Welding & Inspection)' (NSQF Level 4) offered at ITIs in Telangana/AP. NSDC/PMKVY 'Welding and Quality Technician' short course: 515 hours (175 theory + 300 practical + 40 employability/entrepreneurship). APSSDC (Andhra Pradesh State Skill Development Corporation) also lists manual metal arc welding (MMAW/SMAW) training among its courses.
licenses_required_summary: No formal license required to practice welding/fabrication as an independent trade. Shop & Establishment registration and GST registration (above Rs 20 lakh turnover) apply if operating a registered workshop.
government_schemes_summary: PMEGP (KVIC) for setting up a welding/fabrication workshop with subsidy component; PMKVY short-term training; PM Vishwakarma does not list 'Welder' among its 18 covered trades.
data_source: PMEGP/KVIC project-profile case summary; NSDC PMKVY course page; DGT/NCVT ITI syllabus; APSSDC course listing
notes: Investment figure is a single documented PMEGP case, not a generalized official 'typical range,' so confidence is capped at portal-estimate tier (68) for that field despite training data being government-sourced.

name: Carpentry
description: Woodworking trade covering furniture-making, door/window frames, formwork/shuttering carpentry for construction, and finish carpentry (fixing doors, windows, panels).
target_customers: Households, furniture retailers, builders/construction contractors (formwork/shuttering), interior decorators
typical_investment_range_summary: PM Vishwakarma Yojana (which explicitly covers 'Carpenter/Suthar-Badhai' as one of its 18 trades) provides a Rs 15,000 toolkit e-voucher as the government-benchmarked entry-level tool investment, plus access to collateral-free 5%-interest loans (Tranche 1 up to Rs 1,00,000; Tranche 2 up to Rs 2,00,000). A KVIC/PMEGP 'Wooden Furniture' model project profile for a small manufacturing unit shows a larger total project cost of approx. Rs 15.25 lakh (capex Rs 11 lakh + working capital Rs 4.25 lakh) -- this is for a registered workshop/manufacturing unit, not a solo carpenter.
training_availability_summary: DGT/NCVT 'Carpenter' trade, 1 year (1600 hours), NSQF Level 4, offered at ITIs across Telangana/AP; PM Vishwakarma Yojana provides basic + advanced skill training (with Rs 500/day stipend during training) specifically for the Carpenter trade.
licenses_required_summary: No formal license required for independent carpentry work. Shop & Establishment/GST registration applies only if operating a registered shop above the GST turnover threshold.
government_schemes_summary: PM Vishwakarma Yojana (toolkit Rs 15,000 + skill training with stipend + collateral-free loans up to Rs 3 lakh total, at 5% interest) -- directly applicable as Carpenter is one of the 18 listed trades. PMEGP/KVIC for larger workshop/manufacturing setup.
data_source: PIB press release on PM Vishwakarma Yojana; DGT/NCVT ITI Carpenter syllabus (Bharat Skills/NSQF); KVIC PMEGP Wooden Furniture project profile
notes: Toolkit figure (Rs 15,000) and scheme benefits are directly government-sourced (PIB) since Carpenter is explicitly one of PM Vishwakarma's 18 covered trades -- this is the strongest-sourced investment figure in this dataset. The larger PMEGP workshop figure is a separate, higher tier for manufacturing-scale setups.

target_customers: Households, builders/contractors, real-estate developers, commercial property owners

data_source: NSDC 'Construction Painter and Decorator' participant handbook/QP; National Qualifications Register (NQR) qualification file

name: Borewell Drilling Services
description: Rig-owner/operator livelihood providing borewell drilling for domestic drinking-water, agricultural irrigation, and small commercial groundwater extraction.
target_customers: Farmers/agricultural landowners, households (individual house borewells), small industries, real-estate/construction sites
typical_investment_range_summary: No authoritative government cost study for a typical borewell-rig-owner's capital investment (a drilling rig itself is a major capital-equipment purchase, commonly financed rather than self-funded) was located in this search. PENDING_VERIFICATION, portal-estimate-only -- this is a capital-intensive trade very different in scale from hand-tool trades in this dataset.
training_availability_summary: No dedicated DGT/NCVT ITI trade or PMKVY qualification pack specifically for 'borewell driller/rig operator' was identified; skills are typically acquired through on-the-job apprenticeship with an established drilling contractor. PENDING_VERIFICATION for a named formal training body.
licenses_required_summary: In Telangana, borewell drilling requires prior permission/registration from the state Groundwater Department under the Telangana Water, Land and Trees Act (WALTA), 2002, which includes provisions for registration of drilling rigs; borewells must be registered within a stated period after installation, with a site inspection and permit-fee process. Similar groundwater-regulation permission requirements exist in notified/over-exploited areas more broadly under Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA) rules for extraction beyond specified thresholds. These obligations primarily fall on the person commissioning the borewell (landowner) but rig operators/contractors are also affected by rig-registration provisions.
government_schemes_summary: No specific national livelihood/subsidy scheme for borewell-drilling businesses was identified in this search; general Mudra/MSME credit lines would be the applicable route for equipment financing. Agricultural borewell subsidies exist for farmers (the customer side) but that is distinct from a livelihood scheme for the driller.
data_source: Telangana Water, Land and Trees Act, 2002 (India Code); secondary summaries of Telangana Groundwater Department procedure; CGWA NOC guidance
notes: The WALTA Act 2002 licensing/registration requirement is a real, verifiable state law but was accessed via search-engine summary of a .nic.in-hosted document (direct fetch blocked this session) -- recommend direct verification of the Act text and current Groundwater Department rules. Investment and training fields are unverified and flagged PENDING_VERIFICATION.

data_source: ITI 'Pump Operator cum Mechanic' course-detail aggregator pages citing DGT/NCVT CTS structure
notes: Course duration/content sourced from third-party ITI-course aggregator sites rather than a directly-fetched DGT/NCVT primary curriculum document, so capped below the government-sourced ceiling; recommend verifying against the official DGT Bharat Skills portal curriculum PDF when accessible.

name: Tiles Fixing (Tile Mason)
description: Laying, cutting, and finishing of ceramic, vitrified, porcelain, glass or stone tiles on floors and walls for residential, commercial, and industrial buildings.
target_customers: Households, builders/contractors, real-estate developers, commercial interior fit-out projects

training_availability_summary: Construction Skill Development Council of India (CSDCI) offers 'Tile Mason - Basic' (Qualification Code NG-2.5-CO-00750-2023-V1-CSDCI, NSQF Level 2.5) and a higher 'Mason (Tiling)' qualification (QP code CON/Q0104, NSQF Level 4), both deliverable via PMKVY-affiliated training partners under the construction sector skill framework.
licenses_required_summary: No formal license required for independent tile-fixing work. Shop & Establishment/GST registration applies only if operating a registered contracting firm above the GST threshold.
government_schemes_summary: PMKVY short-term training via CSDCI; general Mason (Rajmistri) trade is covered under PM Vishwakarma Yojana (toolkit + training stipend + collateral-free loans), but it is not confirmed whether 'Tile Mason' specifically qualifies under that umbrella -- flagged for verification rather than assumed.
data_source: CSDCI/NSDC Tile Mason qualification pack and NQR qualification file
notes: Qualification codes/NSQF levels are government-sourced (CSDCI/NQR) with reasonable confidence; the PM Vishwakarma applicability and investment-range fields are explicitly uncertain and flagged rather than assumed, per the strict-accuracy instruction.
